title: Number of Subarrays With LCM Equal to K
summary: Given an integer array and a target integer, count the subarrays whose least common multiple equals the target integer.
statement: Given an integer array and a target integer, count the subarrays whose least common multiple equals the target integer. A subarray consists of consecutive elements, and the least common multiple is the smallest number divisible by all elements in the subarray.
constraints: A subarray is a nonempty contiguous segment.
Compute the least common multiple of its elements.
Return the number of subarrays whose LCM is exactly k.
hints: Track counts of distinct LCM values among subarrays ending at the previous index.
Start the singleton at the current value, then append the value to every prior ending subarray and merge equal LCM states.
Discard merged values that cannot divide k, and add the count at k.
Every ending subarray is uniquely generated, while LCM can only stay or increase, making discarded non-divisors unable to recover to k.
